reviews.text: I need to write this because of my kitten... I'm left with the feeling that I was just unlucky, that the professionals who treated her didn't know how or couldn't give her the right solution... She was barely 4 years old and this is where my drama begins... One Sunday she started hiding and wanting to be alone... On Monday I called the clinic and they gave me an appointment for Tuesday... On Tuesday, after tests, etc., they told me it was probably pancreatitis (medication, feeding tube, etc., almost 400 euros)... Wednesday, the kitten was still the same, Thursday, she seemed more lively... Friday, another visit (change of pills, etc., almost 60 euros)... Saturday morning my kitten died... I'm not looking for anything, I don't want anything (I'm not even thinking about the money spent, although they certainly aren't cheap), but I do know a lot of animals (dogs and cats) that have had pancreatitis and are alive and well. healthy...that's why it's so painful for me to think that with proper care, my kitten would surely be here with me...I'm sorry, as I mentioned at the beginning of this post, I needed to write this for my beloved kitten...by the way, I left a message on WhatsApp, sent an email, and today, Tuesday, I've made 12 unanswered calls...
Excellent service and treatment. I took my cat in to be spayed and everything was perfect. Prices are much more affordable than most vets. Highly recommended.
Very good service
My cat loved it! Dr. Sofia is very professional, and the care my cat received was excellent. This is the place where I will always take my pets.
Good
This is the second time we've gone to have our puppy neutered. Excellent treatment, both towards the animal and towards us.
Excellent service. Friendly and professional.
Excellent clinic. I've taken my mixed-breed dog there for rehabilitation and he's improved a lot in just a few sessions.

I've been taking my dog ​​to Lidavet. The last time they didn't figure out what was wrong with his paws. They also sold me some toothpaste that I don't know why I said yes to, but when I went to exchange it for something else because I was never going to use it, they told me they wouldn't exchange it. So, 100 euros down the drain and a very unpleasant experience with the girl at the counter. By the way, the dog is fine now; I took him to the Arago clinic.
We had booked an appointment online and when we arrived they told us there was nothing in their system and they had no openings, without offering any alternative.
They are very professional and attentive; I've never had a problem with them. Their treatment of pets is unparalleled. I recommend them 100%, and their prices are very good too.
They're the best!
I took Kali to be spayed (one year old kitten) and the management both before, on the day of the operation and the post-operative period was great.
Very good service and the cat was comfortable with the check-up, he didn't get nervous. Good treatment and good prices.
Highly recommend! Professionalism, empathy, and a genuine passion for caring for your pet are evident. 🩵 …

From the reception staff to the veterinarians, everyone was incredibly kind and professional. They treated my baby Liam like a little prince and left my Deykor with a spotless smile. They're all so lovely.
I had an excellent experience with my dog ​​during her vaccinations and general check-up. The service was very good throughout the entire process.

Glad to have such a great clinic near us.
Doctor Sofia is the best!!!
My dog ​​is terrified of going to the vet, but we've had a great experience at Lidavet. They're very caring and professional.
Excellent service and care, I definitely recommend it.

This is the second time I'm been now and both times the vets have been great. Unlike some other places, they have always been really patient and empathetic with my dramatic dog! We will definitely be back!

They treat the animals with great tenderness and respect. They explain to you well what happens to them. I take my cat and dog there, even though it's far from my house I take the metro and I'm there in a moment. Plus it's cheap.
Very good service and care

For two years, we had been taking our healthy cat for checkups because he had feline leukemia and FIV, but without any symptoms.
Suddenly, he got sick. In three months, his anemia worsened dramatically, and he lost half his weight. During those three months, the anemia was attributed to the leukemia, without any further testing. Despite them being the professionals, we had doubts about the diagnosis and told them so on more than one occasion.
The final straw was when another colleague (Victoria) saw us and said, and I quote, "If the lymph nodes don't go down in a few days, it's probably lymphoma, but you should already know that (with a cat with leukemia)." And she sent us home. No follow-up, no suggestions. Well, ma'am, there are many reasons why a cat's lymph nodes can swell, especially if no further tests are done.

Since we weren't satisfied, we went to another clinic (NewVet). From the very first moment, they listened to us, assessed his condition, and performed complete blood work and other tests.

RESULT: My cat was DYING from anemia caused by Mycoplasma (bacteria), not from feline leukemia. With medication, he could have been saved, but we arrived too late.
IF YOUR CAT HAS FELINE LEUKEMIA, FIND A CLINIC THAT LOOKS BEYOND THE ILLNESS.

By the way, it's curious that they only respond to "positive" reviews.
Excellent service. They are attentive and caring. The animals are their top priority. I highly recommend them.

Excellent service! My Sphynx cat was diagnosed with a heart problem, and the cardiologist was fantastic! They finally spayed my kitten, and everything went very, very well! I'm super happy and 100% satisfied! I would highly recommend them!

I had an appointment to spay my cat and paid an €85 deposit.
Due to an unforeseen family emergency, I couldn't make the appointment and wasn't able to notify them in advance.

When I contacted the clinic, they didn't offer any rescheduling options or alternative solutions, and I lost the entire deposit.

I understand the cancellation policy, but I believe that in unforeseen situations, there should be more flexibility or alternatives for the client.

Hello, I want to thank the amazing team at LidaVet who helped save my daughter Jhana's life. She was fighting for her life, and I have no words to express my gratitude to this team of veterinarians. Thanks to them, Jhana and I are smiling again. I highly recommend them; your furry friends are in good hands. A thousand thanks to LidaVet, who are the best of the best—100% supportive and understanding.

Except for Dr. Sofia who is a very caring vet in my opinion, I wouldn't ever go there again with my senior dog. There's lot of sales pitches going on, and especially the dental.cleaning which is not very cheap comes across as a factory line. On my opinion, senior dogs should not be held at the facility for 8 hours or more just to wait to get in line for Tuesday's 40 minute teeth cleaning under general anesthesia...it's excessive to have him there this long, stuck in a small cage. Just for the sake of your operational disorganization, I'm not gonna put the welfare of my dog at risk. I also highly encourage readers to take a look at the other reviews...some disturbing and questionable deaths there have also been reported.

Excellent clinic with great professionals. Last fall they treated our dog in an emergency; he was on the verge of death. He's 14 years old. They performed surgery, and now he's living a happy second life. I recommend this clinic 100%.
Good service, good attention.
Fantastic professionals, kind and very loving with the animals. The place is very well maintained and clean. I will continue to bring my pet 🐕 …
Excellent treatment of both animal and human ☺️; accurate diagnosis and prognosis. Very happy.
Very professional, I took my cat in for sterilization and they informed us from the beginning about the whole process, they explained the treatment and follow-up very well.

This wonderful clinic offers a full range of care for your pet, with highly professional staff. Its excellent location, perfect facilities, and staff who truly demonstrate their love for animals make you feel valued.

We had a very good experience with the veterinarian.
The 3 stars are due to the receptionist's treatment of us. She wasn't very helpful, and she quoted us one price for a medication, but the price we received was higher.
They took great care of Bless!

Thank you so much for your review and for trusting LidaVet with your pets' care! We are delighted to hear that you had a positive experience at our clinic and that you appreciate the quality and variety of services we offer. Our entire team works with enthusiasm every day to provide specialized and accessible care for all types of animals, always prioritizing the well-being of your furry (and not-so-furry!) companions. We are always at your service for anything you may need. Warmest regards from the entire LidaVet team!

The treatment of the entire team is excellent. We have had a complicated month of August, the two kittens have become ill. Fortunately, thanks to the professionalism and kindness of all the people who have attended to us at some point, they are both 100% recovered.

We want to thank all the people who have helped us in these weeks, especially Sofia, who has shown a lot of professionalism, knowledge, but also empathy and understanding in very delicate moments.

Thank you very much!!!

Matilda, Lola, Irene and Edgar
Good treatment of our kitten
I had my American Terrier neutered here. He had no problems at all, and everything went well before and after the surgery. The team was super organized and attentive, thank you!

A dog trainer recommended LidaVet for my dog.
Since then, it's been my go-to clinic!
They do a wonderful job, putting so much care and love into every detail!
They're amazing <3

They took excellent care of my pet. The entire process was wonderful, from reception to the veterinarians. I felt at ease from day one, and it's not easy to find someone who makes you feel this way. They are highly professional, the place is clean, and the veterinarians are very kind. If I could give 10 stars, I would.
Very good professionals and the whole team are super nice and friendly.
They care for your pet as if it were their own. Excellent professionals. From now on, they're my trusted vet.
They were the best! They neutered Loki and everything went perfectly. Thank you so much!

Our pet Gala, a Rottweiler, was spayed at Lidavet. The whole team is very professional and caring. She received excellent care, and the small incision on her tummy has healed incredibly well.
Thank you so much for everything! I highly recommend them.
We're so happy with the care our cat received! The operation went perfectly! The service was excellent and everything was super fast! A huge thank you to the team!
Very good, great service, excellent 👌 …

Great! I needed to get two of my cats neutered, and after searching online, I found this place and I'm so happy with everything. The service was excellent; they answered every question kindly, the way they treated my cats was absolutely wonderful, and the prices were very reasonable. The neutering was quick; we took them in the morning, and by midday they were already operated on and awake.
Completely thrilled with everything. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my kitties <3

We took our male German Shepherd, Seth, to be neutered. He received exceptional treatment from both the veterinarian and the surgeon. They are very caring and attentive professionals. The operation was fantastic and without any complications. We are very grateful. We will be back.
Amazing service! They make everything super easy and are incredibly transparent and clear with prices and quotes, which is much appreciated. Thank you so much!
So far the service has been exceptional! Highly recommended and trustworthy

An excellent veterinarian; the assistants and the vet were very kind to us and very caring with Lex. He's not used to being alone, and they were very supportive before, during, and after his neutering. I was nervous about the procedure, and they advised me with great patience. They even followed up by email, checking photos of his scar.
We tried this new clinic ourselves and we liked the explanations and the way they treated our pet. The place is large, clean and spacious, we recommend it.
The service has been amazing. We were able to get our kitten spayed at a very affordable price, and the team is so friendly and always willing to help. I highly recommend them!

It's always a pleasure when we go to them. They care for our babies with such affection, as if they were their own ❤️ Pehuen had his sterilization done and everything went wonderfully! Highly recommended.
A fantastic experience! They were very attentive with the post-operative follow-up. Without a doubt, the entire staff provided excellent and friendly service.

A super friendly and helpful team. They dedicate the necessary time to consultations without rushing and are very kind and caring with patients. I arrived with many doubts about the health of my rescued and recently adopted dog and left with much clearer ideas. Absolutely recommended veterinary center ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I'm giving two stars because of Silvia; she's a dedicated veterinarian with a passion for animals. Ask for her if you go to this clinic, but both the surgeon (a short woman with glasses and curly hair) and one of the receptionists (young, dark-skinned, with straight hair) are quite unpleasant and incompetent. The surgeon tried to convince me that my dog ​​had been bitten by an insect in her mouth because her gums were swollen. I knew that wasn't the case, and she treated me arrogantly, refusing to listen or consider other possibilities. She simply stated that was it, period. Silvia listened and explained other reasons, and it was later confirmed that it wasn't an insect bite. As for the receptionist, after several visits to the clinic and knowing what medication my dog ​​needed, she insisted that I had to pay for a consultation every time I wanted a prescription. She also seemed annoyed by my questions and responded curtly and hesitantly in every interaction. It's understandable to ask questions when I'm about to spend a fortune at their clinic and my dog's health is in their hands. It's as if they don't want to work. Finally, I spoke with Silvia, and she told me that obviously I didn't need to pay for a consultation plus medication every time my dog ​​needed a higher dose. I could talk to her directly; she always listens patiently and advises me on what's best for my dog ​​without having to pay for unnecessary things. Silvia is 10/10. On the other hand, the prices at this "charity" clinic are hardly different from a regular one.
Excellent service and very professional
Everything was excellent. The veterinarians and nurses were wonderful. We had our dog neutered and it went perfectly.

We will be eternally grateful to LidaVet for the excellent care we received these past two months from the entire team, especially Lia, Sofi, and Vicky.
Lia detected two mammary tumors in our dog and guided us on the best course of action to ensure her well-being. Both surgeries have already been performed, one of which also included spaying, and everything has gone very well.

I want to especially highlight the love, care, and professionalism with which they perform their work. They have provided us with a great deal of support, calm, and reassurance at all times, addressing our doubts and fears with great patience and clarity.

I recommend LidaVet because I feel they truly care about the well-being of animals and, importantly, because they have very good prices and payment options.

Thank you, thank you, thank you! ♥️
